item.title: March decline in rents around US is largest since before pandemic
item.description: Average rents in March were down 1.7% compared with March 2025, the largest year-over-year decline since the pandemic created more demand for apartments and drove a historic building boom. item.title: Chair of WA House’s powerful budget-writing committee won’t seek reelection
item.description: Spokane state Rep. Timm Ormsby, the lead budget writer for Washington House Democrats who has served in the Legislature more than two decades, won’t seek reelection this year.
